bagPolicy.summary: The hall FAQ says unchecked bags should be no larger than an ordinary backpack, approximately 18 × 12 × 8 inches; larger and oversized items are not permitted.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The hall’s visitor guidance does not publish a dedicated patron parking lot or universal concert parking rate.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The hall’s visitor guidance does not designate a rideshare pickup or drop-off point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Weill Café at Carnegie Hall offers daytime coffee and meals and pre-concert dining; availability for a particular performance should be checked beforehand.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The hall’s official guidance lists accessible entrances and elevators for its concert halls, plus free assistive listening devices and large-print programs. The Stern Auditorium balcony has no elevator service.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The visitor FAQ does not publish a general concert re-entry rule in the available page text.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The hall publishes box-office contact and ticket-purchase information but no universal concert will-call pickup time in the cited visitor guidance.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The hall’s visitor guidance identifies entrances by performance hall but does not publish a universal concert door-opening time.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
